title: Mitigating Inappropriateness in Image Generation: Can there be Value in Reflecting the World’s Ugliness?

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images using the inappropriate-image-prompts (I2P) dataset and automatically evaluating them with the Q16 classifier to detect toxic concepts such as hate, harassment, violence, self-harm, and illegal activity.
Evaluating model outputs on the 'Sexual' subset of the I2P benchmark using the NudeNet classifier to specifically identify the generation of sexually explicit content and exposed genitalia.
